analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see read maintained. RSI consolidating around 50, MACD histogram showing minimal improvement. 52-week position at 7.2% remains low. ADX at 29.7 shows trend strength but DI direction is uncertain. CCI at -6.4 enters neutral territory. Stochastic %K at 30.2 trending down.
